FAQ

Questions? Answers.

What is Automat?

Automat is an agentic process automation company with two product lines. Automat Workforce gives your team Ace, an AI employee that works in your existing tools. Managed automation is enterprise automation that our team builds, runs, and maintains for you. Both run on the same AI agents, which understand the work, recover when something breaks, and get better as they run.

What is Automat Workforce?

Automat Workforce lets you hire Ace, an AI employee with its own computer, phone number, inbox, and logins. You reach Ace the way you reach any teammate, by email, Slack, text, WhatsApp, a doc comment, or a phone call, and it does the operational work you would otherwise hand to a new hire. No integrations or connectors required.

What is managed automation?

Managed automation is Automat's fully managed enterprise automation service. You share a process, like a screen recording, SOP, or example files, and our team and AI agents build, test, and run the automation for you. You trigger runs from an API or a screen in Automat, with observability, self-healing retries, and human review when needed.

What is the difference between Automat Workforce and managed automation?

Automat Workforce is an AI teammate your team works with directly, best for teams of 2 to 50 that want help across many everyday tasks. Managed automation is a specific, high-volume process that our team builds and runs end to end, best for larger operations in lending, insurance, and healthcare. Many customers start with one and add the other.

How much does Automat cost?

Automat Workforce costs $1,800 per month on an annual plan or $2,000 per month billed month to month, with a 7-day free trial. Managed automation is priced by the scope and volume of the operation, so pricing is set after a short scoping conversation.

Does Automat work with the software we already use?

Yes. Both Automat Workforce and managed automation work with your existing software, with no systems to replace. If a system has an API, the automation uses it. If it does not, the agent uses the same screens a person would, including Windows apps, Citrix, web portals, and internal tools.

How long does it take to get started?

Automat Workforce starts the day you onboard, on a workflow you already care about. Managed automation depends on the process: send a walkthrough or example files before the first call and we can estimate the timeline. Some managed automations go live in days, while moving a larger operation over takes longer.

What support is included?

Every Automat customer works with real people on our team. On Automat Workforce, the team that sets up Ace stays on for changes, upgrades, and support. Managed automation includes Slack support, regular maintenance, and a reply within 24 hours.

Is Automat secure?

Yes. Automat deployments follow SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001. Every run is logged, credentials are encrypted, and access is limited to what you grant, and you can revoke it the way you would for an employee. SSO and SCIM work with your identity provider.

How is Automat different from a chatbot or RPA like UiPath?

A chatbot talks about the work, while Automat does it inside the software you already have. Traditional RPA bots, like UiPath, break when a screen changes and need constant maintenance. Automat's AI agents recover on their own, and a person steps in only when a decision actually needs one.

Which Automat product is right for my team?

Choose Automat Workforce if you want an AI coworker that handles a wide range of tasks for a small or growing team. Choose managed automation if you have a defined, high-volume process, like loan processing or claims intake, that you want built and run for you. Not sure? Talk to us and we will recommend the right fit.

Can we try Automat before committing?

Yes. Start with the 7-day free trial of Automat Workforce on one real workflow and judge it on the work that comes back. For managed automation, talk to us before anything is built. A short walkthrough of the process is enough to tell whether it is worth automating.
